title: Pengintegrasian Kemahiran 6C dan Nilai Malaysia MADANI dalam Meningkatkan Kualiti PDPC Digital Dalam Kalangan Pelajar IPG
abstract: Perkembangan pesat teknologi digital menuntut guru bukan Sahaja menguasai kemahiran teknikal, tetapi juga kompetensi insaniah yang menyokong pembelajaran bermakna dan beretika. Kajian ini meneliti tahap pengamalan kemahiran 6C (komunikasi, kolaborasi, pemikiran kritis, kreativiti, kewarganegaraan dan karakter) serta penerapan nilai Malaysia MADAN] dalam kalangan Pelajar Institut Pendidikan Guru (IPG) semasa praktikum, dan menganalisis hubungannya dengan kualiti pdpc digital. Reka bentuk kajian kuantitatifberbentuk tinjauan digunakan dengan melibatkan 274 Pelajar IP G yang dipilih secara persampelan bertujuan. Instrumen soal selidik berstruktur menunjukkan kebolehpercayaan tinggi (a = 0.863-0.965), dan data dianalisis menggunakan statistik deskriptif serta korelasi Pearson. Dapatan menunjukkan tahap pengamalan kemahiran 6C, penerapan nilai Malaysia MADANI, dan kualiti PdPc digital berada pada tahap tinggi. title: Tahap Konsepsi Versatiliti Pelajar Program Ijazah Sarjana Muda Perguruan (PISMP) Institut Pendidikan Guru Kampus Ilmu Khas
abstract: Teacher Education Institutions aspire to produce versatile, competent, and educator-minded teachers grounded in inclusive education, in line with the aspirations of the Malaysia Madani Framework. The IPG Versatile Student Model was developed using the Fuzzy Delphi Technique to reach consensus among educational experts on the model's key elements. Preliminary findings indicated that four components and eighteen key elements achieved a consensus level exceeding 75%. This consensus reflects a high level of acceptance and agreement among experts. Subsequently, a comprehensive instrument was developed based on the proposed model from the preliminary findings using the Fuzzy Delphi method through expert validation. The questionnaire consisted of a total of 57 items and was administered to PISMP students from the August 2021–July 2026 and August 2021–July 2025 cohorts at a Teacher Education Institute in the Klang Valley. A total of 391 respondents completed the questionnaire. The reliability of all 15 elements in the model demonstrated high Cronbach’s Alpha values ranging from 0.706 to 0.886. title: Meneroka Pendidikan Inklusif Sebagai Medium Pembangunan Profesional Guru Pelatih: Satu Kajian Kualitatif
abstract: This study aims to explore pre-service teachers’ professional knowledge in implementing inclusive education, focusing on their understanding, pedagogical practices, and professional development needs. A qualitative approach was employed using a phenomenographic design, with in-depth interviews conducted among four pre-service teachers who had completed their teaching practicum. The data were analysed thematically to identify key patterns and themes in participants’ experiences. The findings revealed five main themes: understanding of inclusive education, professional knowledge, inclusive pedagogical practices, implementation challenges, and professional development needs. The results indicate that pre-service teachers demonstrate an increasingly holistic understanding of inclusive education; however, they continue to face challenges in adapting instruction to accommodate diverse learners. Professional knowledge and pedagogical competence were identified as key factors in supporting effective inclusive practices. In addition, experiential-based professional development and continuous support were found to be critical in strengthening pre-service teachers’ readiness. The study implie

title: Administrative Leadership's Strategic Planning for AI Integration in Public Secondary Schools: A Qualitative Study in Kuala Lumpur
abstract: The aim of this qualitative study is to examine how administrative leaders in public secondary schools in Kuala Lumpur approach strategic planning for artificial intelligence (AI) integration in education. Three consolidated research objectives guided thc inquiry: (1 ) to explore administrators' understanding and strategic planning of AI integration, (2) to identify challenges and barriers in AI integration planning, and (3) to examine stakeholder engagement and leadership support required for successful AI integration. Through semi-structured interviews with ten experienced school administrators, including principals, senior assistants, and heads of departments, and employing reflexive thematic analysis, the study revealed five major themes: infrastructural and resource considerations, pedagogical transformation and teacher preparedness, ethical and equity concerns, stakeholder engagement strategies, and adaptive leadership approaches. Findings indicate that while administrators recognize AI' s transformative potential, strategic planning remains fragrnented, resource-constrained, and lacking systematic frameworks. title: Daya Ketahanan Pelajar India B40 Pasca Keciciran: Satu Kajian Kes di Daerah Shah Alam
abstract: Student dropout remains a major challenge in the Malaysian education system, particularly among students from low socioeconomic backgrounds. This study aims to explore the factors influencing resilience among Indian students from the B40 socioeconomic group who previously dropped out of school but later resumed their education. A qualitative approach with a case study design was employed, involving six respondents aged between 16 and 22 in the Shah Alam district. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews with students as well as supporting individuals such as family members and peers. Thematic analysis was used to identify key themes related to factors influencing student resilience. The findings reveal that family support emerges as the most dominant factor via high code frequencies and rich narratives. The study proposes several educational interventions to support students at risk of dropping out, including motivational support programs, collaboration between schools and communities, and preventive initiatives. The findings are expected to assist policymakers and educational institutions in developing effective strategies to reduce dropout rates among B40 students.

title: Effectiveness Of CRIGLAM in Enhancing Student Achievement and Intrinsic Motivation
abstract: Cellular respiration remains a challenging topic in biology education due to its abstract nature and low student engagement. While gamification and inquiry-based learning have been widely explored, limited research has examined their structured integration in improving both achievement and intrinsic motivation. This study investigates the effectiveness of the Cellular Respiration Challenge: A Gamified Inquiry-Based Learning Module (CRIGLAM). A quantitative pre-experimental design was employed involving 30 secondary school students. Student achievement was measured using pre- and post-tests, while intrinsic motivation was assessed using the Intrinsic Motivation Inventory (IMI). Data were analysed using paired-samples t-test and one-sample t-test. title: Analisis Deskriptif Lulusan Politeknik dan Kolej Komuniti dalam Kalangan Pelajar Bukan Sains
abstract: Kajian ini membincangkan analisis deskriptif terhadap lulusan daripada aliran Kemanusiaan, Sastera dan Ikhtisas (KSI) yang mengikuti program Pendidikan dan Latihan Teknikal dan Vokasional (TVET) berasaskan STEM di Politeknik dan Kolej Komuniti Malaysia (PolyCC) bagi tempoh 2023 hingga 2025. Pelan Pembangunan Pendidikan Malaysia 2013–2025 mensasarkan penyertaan STEM sebanyak 60%, namun sehingga 2025 masih tidak mencapai sasaran. Oleh yang demikian, 70% pelajar lepasan SPM bidang KSI yang berminat menyertai program berasaskan STEM telah menyambung pengajian di PolyCC sekaligus memenuhi keperluan tenaga kerja bagi pembangunan negara. Kajian ini bertujuan menganalisis taburan lulusan KSI, pencapaian akademik serta tempoh tamat pengajian (GOT), tahap kebolehpasaran graduan (GM), serta membangunkan unjuran graduan PolyCC bagi tempoh 2026–2030. Kajian ini menggunakan persampelan populasi penuh berasaskan data primer pentadbiran di Jabatan Pendidikan Politeknik dan Kolej Komuniti (JPPKK) melibatkan 94,218 lulusan. title: Supporting New Special Educators: A Three-Domain Perspective
abstract: Maintaining effective special educators is critical for inclusive education. Yet, new special educators face challenges that compromise their effectlveness, leading to early attrition. By following PRISMA guidelines, this systematic review synthesizes international evidence published between January 2019 and October 2024 on support systems that build resilience and sustain new special educators. Guided by an established theoretical framework of the induction year, the findings show that effective support works across three interconnected domains, which are professional support (specialized training in IEPs, family partnerships, and differentiated instruction), social support (mentoring, collaborative networks, and administrative backing), and personal support (emotional resources, stress management, and workplace well-being). This review validates the framework across diverse cultural contexts, identifies critical implementation features, and provides a validated roadmap for strengthening induction systems internationally, with relevance for education systems developing comprehensive teacher support infrastructures. title: Reducing Reading Anxiety in Exam: Intervention Strategies for Matriculation Students’ MUET Reading Comprehension
abstract: This study examines targeted interventions designed to reduce reading anxiety while enhancing exam performance among matriculation students preparing for the Malaysian University English Test (MUET) Reading Paper. Achieving Band 3.5 or higher in MUET reading comprehension is needed for university entrance, yet many students underperform due to debilitating anxiety and partially inadequate skills. Therefore, 85 matriculation students from five different classes participated in an 8-week intervention program integrating time management and planning, calming and relaxation techniques, academic vocabulary strategies, and instruction on format and question types. The pre- and post-intervention measurements assessed reading anxiety levels and comprehension performance using validated questionnaires and practice tests. The research employed a quantitative quasi-experimental design with a single group that went through a pre- and post-test. Results revealed significant anxiety reduction, together with improved reading scores. Students achieving an estimated minimum Band 3.5 or higher increased through these strategies. title: A Preliminary Study on The Relationship Between Religiosity and Academic Performance Among Secondary School Students in Shah Alam
abstract: Academic performance among secondary school students is increasingly shaped not only by cognitive and psychological factors but also by spiritual and moral dimensions that remain underexplored in contemporary educational research, particularly in urban Malaysian school contexts, where adolescents face growing challenges related to moral deterioration, digital distractions, and declining motivation to learn. This preliminary study examines the relationship between religiosity and academic performance among secondary school students in Shah Alam, Malaysia. Employing a quantitative survey design, data were collected using a structured questionnaire comprising two constructs: religiosity, operationalized across three dimensions; Islamic worldview, religious practices, and moral conduct; and academic achievement, encompassing study behaviour, motivation, classroom engagement, and perceived performance. A total of 44 secondary school students from a selected urban school in Shah Alam participated in this pilot study. title: Pentaksiran Formatif Pendidikan Matematik Sekolah Rendah Terhadap Pencapaian, Motivasi Dan Penglibatan Murid: Sorotan Literatur Sistematik
abstract: Classroom-based assessment is increasingly recognised as a pedagogical approach that supports learning rather than merely serving as a tool for measuring achievement. In primary mathematics education, formative assessment is widely believed to enhance students’ conceptual understanding; however, existing empirical evidence remains fragmented across different contexts and learning outcomes. This study conducts a systematic literature review to synthesise empirical evidence on the implementation of Classroom-Based Assessment and its implications for student achievement, motivation, and engagement. Guided by the PRISMA protocol, a systematic search was conducted across three major databases—Scopus, ERIC, and Google Scholar—for studies published between 2020 and 2025. A total of 24 empirical studies that met the inclusion criteria were analysed using thematic synthesis. The findings indicate that classroom-based assessment, particularly formative feedback, consistently supports improvements in students’ mathematical understanding and academic performance. title: Meningkatkan Penguasaan Murid Melalui Projek Inovasi ‘EndoPBAV’ dalam Pembelajaran Berasaskan Projek (PBL) untuk Topik Tindak Balas Endotermik
abstract: Bidang Pembelajaran 5.0 Termokimia, topik Tindak balas Eksotermik dan Endotermik subjek Sains tingkatan 3 merupakan topik yang digemari oleh kebanyakan murid. Hasil refleksi pengajaran dan pembelajaran (PdP) sebelum ini mendapati murid tidak dapat memahami bagaimana haba diserap atau dibebaskan ke persekitaran menggunakan konsep tindak balas ini. Justeru, satu intervensi dilaksanakan dengan menjalankan pendekatan Pembelajaran Berasaskan Projek (PBL) melalui projek inovasi ‘EndoPBAV’. Projek inovasi ‘EndoPBAV’ ini menyelesaikan masalah suhu badan tinggi menggunakan konsep tindak balas endotermik iaitu tindak balas kimia yang menyerap haba dari persekitaran dan menyebabkan suhu persekitaran menurun. title: Keberkesanan Board Game Augmented Reality (AR) Konsep dan Ciri Negara terhadap Pengguasaan Murid bagi Mata Pelajaran Pengajian Am
abstract: Kajian ini bertujuan untuk mengenal pasti keberkesanan Board Game Augmented Reality (AR) terhadap pemahaman responden berkaitan penguasaan fakta-fakta penting Bab Konsep Dan Ciri Negara bagi subjek Pengajian Am di Kolej Tingkatan Enam Shah Alam. Objektif utama inovasi ini adalah untuk meneliti keberkesanan mencari ilmu dengan cara menyeronokkkan melalui penglibatan responden secara aktif serta meningkatkan keyakinan mereka melalui pembelajaran secara digital. Reka bentuk kajian yang dipilih ialah kajian tindakan. Antara instrumen yang digunakan dalam kajian ialah ujian pra, pasca, soal selidik serta temu bual. Instrumen ujian pra dan pasca serta soal selidik dianalisis secara deskriptif dengan menggunakan jadual manakala temu bual dianalisis berdasarkan transkripsi mengikut item. Ujian pra dan pos digunakan untuk melihat perbezaan pencapaian responden dalam penulisan idea dan huraian berkaitan konsep dan ciri negara. Sesi pemerhatian dan temu bual dijalankan untuk mengenal pasti minat mereka sebelum dan selepas penggunaan Board Game AR amat jelas bahawa penguasaan terhadap bab ini telah dikuasai dengan sempurna. title: Enhancing Year 3 Student’s Scientific Experience and Understanding in Plant Reproduction Topic Using PTC (Plant Tissue Culture) Kit
abstract: This action research was conducted to assist Year 3 students in improving their understanding towards plant reproduction topic. The technique and kit used in this study were the tissue culture technique and the Plant Tissue Culture (PTC) kit, which involved the use of biotechnology experiments to provide them with a better scientific experience and consequently enhance their understanding of the subject. The participants of this study consisted of 17 primary school students from Sekolah Kebangsaan Ulu Sungai Naman, Julau. These students had low achievement in science subjects and relatively low scientific experiences due to the lack of a fully equipped science laboratory in school. Data for this study were collected through pre- and post-tests and observations made during the intervention program. The data from the pre- and post-tests were analysed using the Statistical Package for Social Sciences (SPSS) version 26, while the observation results were analysed based on changes in physical aspects, responses, facial expressions, student participation, and questioning skills among the students. title: Tahap Pengetahuan, Pemahaman, dan Kesediaan Pelajar IPGK Terhadap Pelaksanaan Pendekatan Design Thinking dalam Pengajaran Dan Pemudahcaraan
abstract: The Design Thinking (DT) approach is recognized as an effective pedagogical strategy for building 21st-century skills such as creativity, collaboration, and problem-solving. However, the level of knowledge, understanding, and readiness of teacher education students at the Teacher Education Institutes (IPG) to integrate DT into teaching and facilitation (PdPc) remains underexplored. This quantitative survey study aimed to explore the level of (1) knowledge, (2) understanding, and (3) readiness of IPG teacher education students towards DT, and to analyze the relationship between these three variables. A total of 153 teacher education students participated as respondents through a questionnaire instrument. Data were analyzed descriptively and inferentially. Findings indicate that the level of students' knowledge, understanding, and readiness towards DT is high. Correlation analysis further revealed a significant relationship among students' knowledge, understanding, and readiness to apply DT. title: The Application of Digital Technology and the Learning Characteristics of Gen Z in Institutes of Teacher Education
abstract: Research on Institutes of Teacher Education is essential, as these institutions shape future educators who will influence the next generation of learners. This study examines how digital technology impacts teacher trainees in teacher education programs, providing critical insights into improving teaching methodologies, curriculum development, and instructional strategies. A quantitative survey research design was employed, involving 215 teacher trainees from the Institute of Teacher Education Ilmu Khas Campus, selected through simple random sampling. The findings reveal that Gen Z teacher trainees exhibit a strong preference for rapid knowledge acquisition (Mean = 4.07), visually engaging content (Mean = 4.00), and technology-driven learning experiences (Mean = 3.91). title: Aktiviti Usrah dalam kalangan Siswa Guru Muslim Institusi Pendidikan Malaysia
abstract: Usrah (Islamic study circle) is one of the activities aimed at developing human potential as vicegerents (khalifah) on Allah’s earth. This activity involves various levels of participation, including teacher trainees at teacher education institutes. This study aims to examine the involvement of teacher trainees in usrah activities and their impact on spiritual development at the Institute of Teacher Education (IPG) in the Central Zone of Malaysia. The study involved 507 respondents, consisting of teacher trainees from semesters one to eight at the Institute of Teacher Education Malaysia (IPGM) in the Central Zone. The data collected were analyzed using the Statistical Package for Social Sciences (SPSS) for Windows (version 26.0) to obtain mean scores. The results showed that the overall mean score for usrah activities among teacher trainees in IPGM Central Zone was 4.5. The findings indicate that involvement in usrah activities has a significant impact on the spiritual development of Muslim teacher trainees. title: The Effectiveness of Group Discussions in Preparing for MUET Speaking Among Form 6 Students in a Secondary School in Kuala Lumpur
abstract: This research seeks to determine the efficacy of a group discussion-oriented MUET speaking preparation approach for Form 6 (a Level 6 category under the Malaysian education system) learners preparing for MUET, otherwise known as the Malaysian University English Test. Although conventional methods of teaching have been widely employed, performance of students in the speaking component of the MUET is considered low. Speech impediments, lack of vocabulary and test anxiety interfere with some students’ success. Common teaching methods, lecture by teacher and practice work of individuals do not always work to develop both interactive and communicative capabilities. Filling this gap, the paper investigates whether structured group discussions may provide a better substitute. Purposive sampling was used and a quasi-experimental study design was used.76 students from a secondary school in Kuala Lumpur were selected and divided into an experimental group (discussion) and a control group (conventional method). title: Keberkesanan Program Menyemarak Nyala Rasa Guru terhadap Ketahanan Mental Diri Pelajar
abstract: Program Menyemarak Nyala Rasa Guru aims to share knowledge and expertise while offering exposure and experience through excellent teachers who received awards both national and international levels via professional learning practices. This preliminary study seeks to analyze the effectiveness of the program in supporting the mental readiness and resilience levels of PISMP (Bachelor Degree of Teaching Program) students in facing teaching challenges of the present day. The study, employing a survey method via a google form questionnaire, involved 195 PISMP students across various fields of study. Data were analyzed using the Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 27.0. Mean and standard deviation analyses were conducted to assess the program’s impact on the mental readiness of PISMP students, while inferential statistics, specifically Pearson correlation analysis, was used to examine the relationship between students' resilience and the challenges of the teaching profession. title: Keperluan Pembelajaran Khidmat Bakti TVET di Institut Pendidikan Guru Malaysia: Tinjauan Literatur Sistematik
abstract: Service Learning (SL) is a servce based learning method that integrates experiential learning with community service and volunteering activities. The implementation of SL exposes students to the application of practical and theoretical skills in real situations. This study aims to identify the needs of SL in Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) at the Malaysian Institute of Teacher Education (IPGM). This study explore literature reviews on SL from both domestic and international sources. The study findings show that IPGM needs to implement SL in TVET at IPGM because it is in line with IPGM policies and current educational needs. At the end of the study, the researcher put forward several suggestions to attract researchers to do more research on SL in Technical and Vocational Education especially and in the education field generally.

title: Promoting Inclusion and Equity: Blended EFL Learning in Higher Education in Hebei, China
abstract: The ubiquitous internet connection and the rapid development of the learning management system make blended learning (BL) a feasible way to eliminate educational disparity and achieve inclusive and equitable quality higher education for all, regardless of gender and background in China. This study aims to ascertain whether students’ blended learning experience (BLE) differs according to students’ gender and place of residence and to find out the difference. Sequential mixed methods approach was used including a questionnaire survey of a sample of 530 EFL learners and two qualitative focus group interviews of 12 participants. Results showed that after one year of BL, English as a Foreign Language (EFL) students had positive BLE in general, and students from the big city and the town had better BLE than students from the countryside. Besides, students of different genders and places of residence varied in their perceptions of BL. Considering these findings helps us better design BL to achieve equitable quality learning.
